findings.message: Multiple root-level HTML files with data-composition-id: index.html, nl.html. The runtime may discover both as entry points, causing duplicate audio playback.
findings.fixHint: A project should have exactly one root index.html with data-composition-id. Remove or rename extra files.

findings.message: Audible clips overlap on Studio track 20: assets/audio/fr/p03.wav at 5.39-7.35s and assets/audio/fr/p04.wav at 7.34-10.31s. Both play at once whatever their track (the render mixes every audible clip; data-track-index only picks the Studio lane), and Studio draws them over each other in that lane.
findings.fixHint: If both should sound (a whoosh into a hit), give one its own data-track-index; the mix does not change. If one is a leftover duplicate, remove it or move it so the windows do not overlap.

findings.message: Detected 2 matching img entries with the same source/start/duration.
findings.fixHint: Avoid duplicated media nodes that can be discovered twice during compilation.

findings.message: Failed to load npm/gsap@3.14.2/dist/gsap.min.js: net::ERR_TUNNEL_CONNECTION_FAILED
Audio "vo-p13" is 1.23s but its slot (data-duration) is 1.41s — the slot is shortened to the media length when rendered. Set data-duration to ~1.23s if that isn't intended.
data-motion-blur="on" is set but nothing in the composition moves fast enough to blur, so it has no effect
findings.fixHint: animate an element's transform or position by 2+ px per frame; if the motion is set from a timeline callback (onUpdate, render(t)), add data-motion-blur-events="on"; otherwise drop data-motion-blur

findings.message: Two text blocks overlap and may render unreadable.
findings.fixHint: Give each block its own zone, or put data-layout-allow-overlap on the text or on a container inside the scene. A marker on the scene root does not apply. Decoration nobody needs to read can take data-layout-ignore.
